head_commit.message:
feat(tui): add "clean context and implement" option to Plan Mode popup

When a plan is completed in Plan Mode, the implementation popup now
offers three choices instead of two:

1. "Yes, clean context and implement" — starts a fresh session with
   only the plan text, avoiding stale context from exploration.
2. "Yes, implement this plan" — existing behavior (same session).
3. "No, stay in Plan mode" — existing behavior.

The new option captures the finalized plan text, tears down the current
thread, and boots a clean session with the plan auto-submitted as the
first user message in Default mode. This mirrors the "compact and
continue" pattern used elsewhere in the codebase.

The option is disabled (with a visible reason) when no plan text is
available.

head_commit.message:
fix(exec): suppress duplicate output when stdout is a terminal

codex exec printed the agent response twice — once to stderr during
streaming and again to stdout in print_final_output(). Skip the
stdout copy when stdout is a TTY so interactive users see the message
only once. Piped/redirected stdout is unaffected.

Fixes https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/12566
